Hi Emma — thanks for the details. I'm Marissa on the Finance/Procurement side. A quick clarification on policy so you have the right expectations:

- Standard policy: Purchase orders are required for any multi-month commitments or vendors where estimated spend > $5k per month or when a contract is executed.
- Trial exception: We can approve an invoice-only path for single-month trials up to $10k total provided the following are submitted and validated:
  1) Completed Redwood vendor onboarding form (PDF).
  2) Valid W-9 (for US entities) or equivalent tax form.
  3) Confirmation of vendor banking details or payment instructions.
  4) Acceptance of our standard trial terms (I can send a one-page addendum).

Operationally, once we receive items 1–3 we can create a temporary vendor record and issue an invoice route; we'll tag the vendor as "trial-invoice-only" and set a spend cap. If Cloudhaven anticipates work that would push spend beyond $10k during the trial, we will need a PO and a brief SOW.

Karthik — I'm flagging this for your awareness in case Solutions/Legal wants to review the scope.

Emma — if you'd like, I can open a short DocuSign for the trial addendum and provide wire instructions for invoicing. Attached: Redwood_onboarding_form_fillable.pdf.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
